scripts.build: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:rust && pnpm run build:browser && pnpm run build:phase5
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:typescript && pnpm run typecheck:rust && pnpm run typecheck:browser
scripts.test: pnpm run build:phase2-binaries && pnpm run test:typescript && pnpm run test:rust && node --test scripts/check-forbidden-imports.test.mjs scripts/record-phase4-evidence.test.mjs test/capability-contract.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:phase2-binaries && pnpm run build:browser && playwright test --config devtools/browser/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:phase5: pnpm run build:typescript && playwright test --config examples/playwright.config.ts
scripts.record:phase5:codex: pnpm run build:typescript && playwright test --config examples/playwright.real.config.ts
scripts.check:phase0-parity: vitest run src/tracer/phase0-runner.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core runs_the_mock_core_path_with_stable_output && node -e "process.stdout.write('Rust and TypeScript Phase 0 tracer output matches the shared golden fixture.\n')"
scripts.check:phase1-parity: vitest run src/reducer/session-reducer.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core phase1_fixture_parity && node -e "process.stdout.write('Rust and TypeScript Phase 1 reducer summaries match the shared golden fixtures.\n')"
scripts.trace:phase0:rust: pnpm run build:rust && cargo run --quiet --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core --bin phase0-tracer
scripts.trace:phase2: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:phase2-binaries && node dist/cli/phase2-mock-core.js
scripts.trace:phase3: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:phase2-binaries && node dist/cli/phase3-recovery.js
scripts.trace:phase7: pnpm run build:typescript && cargo build --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core --bin paperclip-runnerd && node dist/cli/phase7-live.js
scripts.record:phase3: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:phase2-binaries && node scripts/record-phase3-evidence.mjs
scripts.browser:dev: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:phase2-binaries && vite --config vite.config.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:phase1-goldens && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:phase5 && pnpm run check:browser-tokens && pnpm run test:browser && pnpm run test:browser:phase5 && pnpm run check:forbidden-imports && pnpm run docs:validate && pnpm run check:phase0-parity && pnpm run check:phase1-parity && pnpm run trace:phase0 && pnpm run replay:phase1 && pnpm run trace:phase2 -- --quiet && pnpm run trace:phase3
